Title: Masterblend Hydroponic Nutrients: Rates per Gallon & Mixing
Description: Masterblend: per gallon dissolve 2.4 g 4-18-38, then 1.5 g Epsom salt, then 2.4 g calcium nitrate; half rate for seedlings. Hold pH 5.5–6.5. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
